name: secure-browser-agent
description: Safe wrapper around agent-browser for authenticated browser analysis and scraping.

scripts.probe:agent-proof-closeout-status: node src/cli.mjs agent-proof-closeout --include-compact-command-audit --write --out operator/agent-proof-closeout-latest.json --format compact >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs agent-proof-closeout-status --format compact
scripts.probe:agent-workflow-existing-tab: node src/cli.mjs agent-workflow --task existing-tab --intent inspect --match-origin https://github.com --match-path /notifications --chrome-extension-prepared yes --chrome-extension-backend-available yes --format compact
scripts.probe:agent-backend-select: node src/cli.mjs agent-backend-select --task existing-tab --chrome-mcp-connected yes --chrome-mcp-page-list-ok yes --chrome-mcp-page-count 1 --format compact
scripts.probe:agent-control-plane: node src/cli.mjs agent-control-plane --write --task existing-tab --chrome-mcp-connected yes --chrome-mcp-page-list-ok yes --chrome-mcp-page-count 1 --format compact
scripts.probe:chrome-mcp-observation:
node src/cli.mjs chrome-mcp-observation --status-text 'Chrome DevTools MCP Status

Connected: yes
Tools: 29' --list-pages-text 'Pages:
- 0: Example https://example.com/' --source package-probe --format compact
scripts.probe:chrome-mcp-observation-flags: node src/cli.mjs chrome-mcp-observation --observed-connected yes --observed-tools 29 --observed-page-list-ok no --observed-list-pages-timed-out yes --observed-last-error 'Network.enable timed out' --source package-probe-normalized --format compact
scripts.probe:chrome-mcp-timeout-plan: node src/cli.mjs chrome-mcp-timeout-plan --write --observed-connected yes --observed-tools 29 --observed-last-error 'Network.enable timed out' --observed-source package-probe --format compact
scripts.probe:regular-chrome-use-extension-reins:
node src/cli.mjs regular-chrome-use --intent inspect --status-text 'Chrome DevTools MCP Status

Connected: yes
Tools: 29' --list-pages-text 'Chrome DevTools MCP failed: Execution failed: Request timed out after 30000ms' --chrome-extension-prepared yes --chrome-extension-backend-available no --chrome-extension-backend-last-error 'Transport closed' --chrome-extension-window-retry-attempted yes --format compact
scripts.probe:regular-chrome-use-apple-events: node src/cli.mjs regular-chrome-use --intent inspect --chrome-mcp-connected yes --chrome-mcp-page-list-ok no --chrome-mcp-last-error 'Network.enable timed out' --chrome-extension-prepared yes --chrome-extension-backend-available no --apple-events-active-tab-observed yes --apple-events-javascript-allowed no --format compact
scripts.probe:chrome-extension-troubleshoot: node src/cli.mjs chrome-extension-troubleshoot --backend-available no --backend-last-error 'Browser is not available: extension' --format compact
scripts.probe:chrome-extension-troubleshoot-afte: node src/cli.mjs chrome-extension-troubleshoot --backend-available no --backend-last-error 'Transport closed' --profile-window-retry-attempted yes --format compact
scripts.probe:chrome-extension-claim-plan: node src/cli.mjs chrome-extension-claim-plan --backend-ready yes --intent inspect --match-origin https://github.com --match-path /notifications --format compact
scripts.probe:secret-run-plan: node src/cli.mjs secret-run-plan --mode service-account --command target-login-capture --target-dir runs/target-packs/github --format compact
scripts.probe:secret-run-select: node src/cli.mjs secret-run-select --command target-login-capture --target-dir runs/target-packs/github --format compact
scripts.probe:target-benchmark: node src/cli.mjs target-benchmark runs/target-packs/example-public --recipes observe,inspect --iterations 1 --format markdown
scripts.probe:completion-proof-bundle-status: node src/cli.mjs completion-proof-bundle --include-compact-command-audit --write --out operator/completion-proof-bundle-latest.json --format compact >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs completion-proof-bundle-status --format compact
scripts.probe:operator-pack-apple-events: node src/cli.mjs operator-pack --chrome-mcp-connected yes --chrome-mcp-page-list-ok no --chrome-mcp-last-error 'Network.enable timed out' --chrome-extension-backend-available no --chrome-extension-backend-last-error 'Transport closed' --apple-events-active-tab-observed yes --apple-events-javascript-allowed no --format compact

scripts.probe:scaffold: node src/cli.mjs scaffold-target example-public --origin https://example.com --page-url https://example.com --query 'example domain' --permissions clipboard,downloads --force
scripts.probe:target-proof-plan: node src/cli.mjs scaffold-target example-public --origin https://example.com --page-url https://example.com --query 'example domain' --permissions clipboard,downloads --force >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs target-proof-plan runs/target-packs/example-public --format compact
scripts.probe:target-proof-capture: node src/cli.mjs scaffold-target example-public --origin https://example.com --page-url https://example.com --query 'example domain' --permissions clipboard,downloads --force >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs target-proof-capture runs/target-packs/example-public --format markdown
scripts.probe:target-batch: node src/cli.mjs scaffold-target example-public --origin https://example.com --page-url https://example.com --query 'example domain' --permissions clipboard,downloads --force >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs target-batch runs/target-packs/example-public --format compact
scripts.probe:target-proof: node src/cli.mjs scaffold-target example-public --origin https://example.com --page-url https://example.com --query 'example domain' --permissions clipboard,downloads --force >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs target-proof runs/target-packs/example-public --format markdown
scripts.probe:target-bootstrap-plan: node src/cli.mjs target-bootstrap-plan --name vendor-service --origin https://app.vendor-service.com,https://accounts.vendor-service.com --login-url https://accounts.vendor-service.com/login --page-url https://app.vendor-service.com/dashboard --format compact
scripts.probe:target-auth-check: node src/cli.mjs scaffold-target example-public --origin https://example.com --page-url https://example.com --query 'example domain' --permissions clipboard,downloads --force >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs target-auth-check runs/target-packs/example-public --format markdown
scripts.probe:target-handoff-status: node src/cli.mjs target-login-capture runs/target-packs/example-public --dry-run --handoff-out operator-handoff.json --format json >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs target-handoff-status runs/target-packs/example-public --handoff operator-handoff.json --format compact
scripts.probe:target-handoff-run: node src/cli.mjs target-login-capture runs/target-packs/example-public --dry-run --handoff-out operator-handoff.json --format json >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs target-handoff-run runs/target-packs/example-public --handoff operator-handoff.json --command post-login-capture --format markdown
scripts.probe:target-handoff-resume: node src/cli.mjs target-login-capture runs/target-packs/example-public --dry-run --handoff-out operator-handoff.json --format json >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs target-handoff-resume runs/target-packs/example-public --handoff operator-handoff.json --format compact
scripts.probe:target-permissions: node src/cli.mjs target-permissions runs/target-packs/example-public status && node src/cli.mjs target-permissions runs/target-packs/example-public set --allow clipboard,downloads && node src/cli.mjs target-permissions runs/target-packs/example-public apply && node src/cli.mjs target-permissions runs/target-packs/example-public status
scripts.probe:target-daemon: node src/cli.mjs target-daemon runs/target-packs/example-public start && node src/cli.mjs target-daemon runs/target-packs/example-public status && node src/cli.mjs target-scrape runs/target-packs/example-public --daemon && node src/cli.mjs target-daemon runs/target-packs/example-public stop
scripts.probe:target-autostart: node src/cli.mjs target-autostart runs/target-packs/example-public plan && node src/cli.mjs target-autostart runs/target-packs/example-public write && node src/cli.mjs target-autostart runs/target-packs/example-public status && node src/cli.mjs target-autostart runs/target-packs/example-public remove
scripts.probe:target-run-status: node src/cli.mjs target-run-status runs/target-packs/example-public operate --format compact
scripts.probe:target-operate-add: node src/cli.mjs target-operate-add runs/target-packs/example-public click --selector 'a[href]' --as click_first_link --dry-run
scripts.probe:lightpanda: node src/cli.mjs extract 'data:text/html,Link' --selector a --fields text,href --profile public --engine lightpanda
scripts.verify:ci: node --check src/cli.mjs && npm run test:ci && npm run probe:compact-command-audit-ci && npm run probe:mcp-compact && node src/cli.mjs doctor --offline
scripts.verify: node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm run probe:compact-command-audit-all && npm run probe:mcp-compact && node src/cli.mjs doctor --offline
